gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil has big round lowercase bowls and a modern, friendly look. And Expose above it is tight and striking, so the body feels like a deep breath after a sharp line.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-telugu: Tight, striking, a little severe up top. Anek Telugu follows with wide, tall bowls that stay open like an unlatched hook, so the sans body feels easygoing at any size you pick.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anuphan: Expose is compressed and striking, with caps that sit almost level with its lowercase. Anuphan takes over with big round bowls and open curves, giving the pair a crisp, generous quality.
gen-fs-expose-gf-arimo: Arimo reads smooth and tidy, with a tall mean line. Under Expose's compressed headings, its rounded letters leave spacious gaps at the terminals, so paragraphs of sans-serif text stay easy on the eye.
gen-fs-expose-gf-athiti: Approachable is the first word for Athiti, whose s shows a gap you can see through. Athiti runs on a high mean line and one uniform line width, so a long stretch of plain sans feels steady under Expose's tight, striking headings.
gen-fs-expose-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps wide-set terminals on its s. Below the compressed, refined Expose, it feels like a plain sans that lets the heading make the noise while the text stays plainly spoken.
gen-fs-expose-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Expose sets striking, refined letters with almost no gap between its x-height and caps, a tightly packed cadence. It earns its keep big and short, while Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono stays open.
gen-fs-expose-gf-biryani: Expose compresses its rhythm into something striking and refined, with barely a pause between lowercase and caps. Biryani counters with a large eye on every e and no thick-and-thin shifts, a plain sans that stays unclogged.
gen-fs-expose-gf-blinker: Expose brings a striking, compressed cadence, with lowercase nearly reaching the caps. And Blinker keeps its lines at a constant thickness, so the sans-serif text feels open and readable beneath the heading's tight energy.
gen-fs-expose-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads modern and tidy, with a high x-height. Its generous c opening gives Expose's compressed, striking headings room to push forward, and that sharp-versus-open difference is the pair's best trait.
